Images and model credits

The Sampson equipment logo is commissioned illustrated branding. Vehicle and machinery illustrations are not photographs of customer work.

Complete assembly and machinery models

Ten licensed 3D models show complete assemblies and machinery. They include scans of real objects and authored 3D models. Geometry and textures have been optimized for web display. Materials, lighting, framing and camera motion have been adapted. These are illustrative examples and do not imply manufacturer affiliation or a commitment to service every model shown.

Diesel engine

By andreviewport. Original model. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Geometry optimized and Meshopt compressed for web display. Textures resized and compressed where present. Framing, lighting and camera motion adapted. Engine paint and material finish adapted to the Sampson palette; unused texture coordinates removed. Static engine poster cropped and resized from the original model preview.

Transmission

By Artec 3D / Artec Group inc.. Original model. Licensed under CC BY 3.0.

Geometry optimized and Meshopt compressed for web display. Textures resized and compressed where present. Framing, lighting and camera motion adapted. Original scan reduced to 220000 triangles, converted to GLB and given a cast metal material.
